alwaysOpen.description: Whether multiple items can be open at once.

x-plume::alert.description: Displays a callout for user attention.

x-plume::alert-dialog.description: Modal dialog specifically designed for alerting users to important information or actions.

x-plume::aspect.description: A container component to maintain consistent proportions for media and content.

x-plume::breadcrumb.description: Displays the path to the current resource using a hierarchy of links.

href.description: URL to navigate to or submit to. Renders as an <a> tag unless $method is provided.

confirm.description: Native confirmation message to display before action.

x-plume::button.description: Displays a button or a component that looks like a button.
x-plume::button.usage:
<x-plume::button style="primary" icon="icon-[fluent--save-24-regular]">Save Changes</x-plume::button>

<x-plume::button 
    href="/users/1" 
    method="DELETE" 
    confirm="Are you sure you want to delete this user?"
    onSuccess="$success('User deleted')">
    Delete User
</x-plume::button>

x-plume::button.loader.description: Button with built-in loading state management.

x-plume::button.toggle.description: Button that toggles between two states.

model.description: AlpineJS model name for the selected date(s).

x-plume::card.description: Displays a card with header, content, and footer.

autoplay.description: Whether to automatically cycle through slides.

interval.description: Duration in milliseconds between slide changes when autoplay is on.

onSlideChange.description: AlpineJS expression or function to call when the active slide changes.

x-plume::carousel.description: A slideshow component for cycling through elements.

x-plume::chart.description: Basic chart component for data visualization (bar, line).

x-plume::code.description: A component for displaying code snippets with a copy-to-clipboard feature.

data.description: Array of objects to display (client-side data).

columns.description: Column definitions: [{key: 'name', label: 'Name', sortable: true, cellClass: '...', headerClass: '...', constructed: '...'}].

searchable.description: Whether to show a search input for filtering.

sortable.description: Whether to enable column sorting globally.

url.description: API endpoint URL for server-side fetching.

fixedHeight.description: If true, maintains a minimum height based on perPage to prevent layout shifts.

x-plume::data-table.description: Advanced table with sorting, filtering, and pagination. Powered by AlpineJS. Supports client-side data or server-side fetching via URL.
x-plume::data-table.usage: @php $cols = [ ['key' => 'name', 'label' => 'Name', 'sortable' => true], ['key' => 'email', 'label' => 'Email', 'sortable' => true], ['key' => 'role', 'label' => 'Role', 'constructed' => '{role}'] ]; @endphp

x-plume::figure.description: Enhanced image component with captions, aspect ratio control, and support for modern image formats.

resetButton.description: Label for an automatic reset button.

resetOnSuccess.description: Whether to reset the form data to initial state after success.

onSuccess.description: AlpineJS expression or callback function to execute on success.

onError.description: AlpineJS expression or callback function to execute on error.

showAlerts.description: Whether to automatically show success/error alerts.

inline.description: Renders form elements in a horizontal flex layout.

x-plume::form.description: A robust form container with AJAX submission, validation error handling, and success feedback.
x-plume::form.usage:
<x-plume::form 
    action="/profile" 
    method="PUT" 
    :form-data="$user"
    submit-button="Update Profile"
    onSuccess="$success('Profile saved!')"
>
    <x-plume::form.input name="name" label="Full Name" />
    <x-plume::form.input name="email" label="Email Address" />
</x-plume::form>

onSelect.description: AlpineJS expression or function to call when an option is selected.

model.description: AlpineJS model name for the search query.

onSelect.description: AlpineJS expression or function to call when a result is selected.

x-plume::search.description: Styled search input with an integrated results dropdown.
x-plume::search.usage:
<x-plume::search model="searchQuery" placeholder="Find users...">
    <x-slot:results>
        <template x-for="user in filteredUsers">
            <x-plume::search.result 
                ::title="user.name" 
                ::href="'/users/' + user.id" 
                ::payload="user"
            />
        </template>
    </x-slot:results>
</x-plume::search>

x-plume::search.result.description: An individual result item within a search component.

x-plume::stepper.description: Guide users through multi-step processes with clear visual indicators.
x-plume::stepper.usage:
<x-plume::stepper active="1">
    <x-plume::stepper.step title="Personal Info" step="1">
        Step 1 content...
    </x-plume::stepper.step>
    <x-plume::stepper.step title="Address" step="2">
        Step 2 content...
    </x-plume::stepper.step>
</x-plume::stepper>

default.description: The key of the tab to be active by default.

side.description: Side to display the tab list: 'top', 'bottom', 'left', 'right'.

onTabChange.description: AlpineJS expression or function to call when the active tab changes.

x-plume::tabs.description: A set of layered sections of content, known as tab panels, that are displayed one at a time.
x-plume::tabs.usage:
<x-plume::tabs default="profile">
    <x-plume::tabs.group>
        <x-plume::tabs.item for="profile">Profile</x-plume::tabs.item>
        <x-plume::tabs.item for="settings">Settings</x-plume::tabs.item>
    </x-plume::tabs.group>
    
    <x-plume::tabs.panel name="profile">
        Profile Content
    </x-plume::tabs.panel>
    <x-plume::tabs.panel name="settings">
        Settings Content
    </x-plume::tabs.panel>
</x-plume::tabs>

x-plume::tabs.panel.description: Content panel for a specific tab.
